requirement_text: The signals state 1 equal TRUE has to be transmitted if the `` distance within ego lane '' is fulfilled sufficiently for a stationary object, independent of whether it is the object with the lowest distance or an object with larger distance or a hidden object.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the signal state to be 1 (TRUE) whenever the distance within ego lane is sufficiently fulfilled for a stationary object, so that any such object is flagged.
technical_task: Transmit the signal with state 1 equal TRUE when the "distance within ego lane" condition is sufficiently met for a stationary object, regardless of whether it is the object with the lowest distance, an object with larger distance or a hidden object.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stationary object that sufficiently fulfils the distance within ego lane, when the signal is evaluated, then it is transmitted with state 1 equal TRUE.
Given the object is not the one with the lowest distance, or is a hidden object, when the condition is fulfilled, then the signal is still transmitted with state 1.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. "Sufficiently" is not defined in the requirement.

requirement_text: The product shall synchronize contacts and appointments in an acceptable time.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall synchronize contacts and appointments in an acceptable time.'
clarification_questions: What synchronization time counts as "acceptable" for contacts and appointments?
How many contacts and appointments is it measured with?

requirement_text: System shall support privileged access for external collaborators, ensuring effective collaboration.
user_story: As a project owner, I want to give external collaborators privileged access, so that they can work with my team.
technical_task: Provide a privileged access role for external collaborators.
acceptance_criteria: Given an external collaborator, when privileged access is granted, then the collaborator can use the privileged functions.
Given an external collaborator without privileged access, when the collaborator tries a privileged function, then it is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: project owner. Which privileges are included is not stated, and "effective collaboration" is not tested.

requirement_text: The global synchronous timer shall be realigned by exchanging and voting the timer value. The timer value will stop incrementing until the realignment of the timer is complete.
requirement_text_raw: The global synchronous timer shall (3.2.2.4.9) be realigned by exchanging and voting the timer value.  The timer value will stop incrementing until the realignment of the timer is complete.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the global synchronous timer realigned by exchanging and voting on timer values and frozen during realignment, so that all members agree on the time.
technical_task: Realign the global synchronous timer by exchanging and voting the timer value and hold the timer value constant until realignment completes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a realignment of the global synchronous timer, when it runs, then the timer value is exchanged and voted.
Given a realignment is in progress, when the timer is read, then its value does not increment until realignment is complete.

requirement_text: For data with enough structuring, web scraping will be used to programmatically extract all the data needed and store it in our database.
user_story: As a data engineer, I want data that is structured enough to be extracted by web scraping and stored in our database, so that I do not enter it by hand.
technical_task: Use web scraping to programmatically extract the needed data from sufficiently structured sources and store it in the database.
acceptance_criteria: Given a source with enough structure, when scraping runs, then all the needed data is extracted.
Given extracted data, when the run finishes, then it is stored in the database.
rationale: Role assumed: data engineer. "Enough structure" is not defined.

requirement_text: The system shall allow adding new items to the estimation list during a session.
user_story: As a session participant, I want to add new items to the estimation list during a session, so that late topics can be covered.
technical_task: Allow items to be added to the estimation list while a session is running.
acceptance_criteria: Given a running session, when the user adds an item, then it appears in the estimation list.
Given an item added during a session, when the list is viewed, then the item is available for estimation.

requirement_text: User shall register for the examination.
user_story: As a candidate, I want to register for the examination, so that I can sit it.
technical_task: Provide an examination registration function.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the candidate submits valid details, then the candidate is registered for the examination.
Given the registration form, when required details are missing, then the registration is not accepted.

requirement_text: System shall authenticate the payment details and proceed to the next interface.
user_story: As a customer, I want my payment details authenticated before I move to the next screen, so that the payment is legitimate.
technical_task: Authenticate the payment details and move on to the next interface when they are accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Given payment details, when they are submitted, then the system authenticates them.
Given authenticated payment details, when the check succeeds, then the next interface is shown.

requirement_text: And HCP chooses to add or edit patient specific instructions.
requirement_text_raw: And HCP chooses to add  or edit  patient specific instructions.
rationale: The sentence is a fragment starting with "And" and states no complete requirement.
clarification_questions: What happens before this step, and which instructions are meant?
What must the system do when the HCP chooses to add or edit instructions?

requirement_text: The solution should provide an override function (that requires a reason and the pharmacist's user ID) to dispense a non-authorized or non-formulary medication in special circumstances.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want an override function that asks for a reason and my user ID, so that I can dispense a non-authorized or non-formulary medication in special circumstances.
technical_task: Provide an override function that requires a reason and the pharmacist's user ID before a non-authorized or non-formulary medication is dispensed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a non-authorized or non-formulary medication, when the pharmacist uses the override function, then a reason and the pharmacist's user ID are required.
Given a reason and the user ID are entered, when the override is confirmed, then the medication can be dispensed.
rationale: Role stated: pharmacist. "Special circumstances" are not defined.

requirement_text: System shall display a pop-up confirming the successful download of the video.
user_story: As a user, I want a pop-up confirming my video download succeeded, so that I know it is complete.
technical_task: Show a pop-up when a video download completes successfully.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video download, when it completes successfully, then a pop-up confirms it.
Given a download that fails, when it ends, then the success pop-up is not shown.

requirement_text: Interface will be presented in a web browser.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface in a web browser, so that I need no installation.
technical_task: Present the interface in a web browser.
acceptance_criteria: Given a web browser, when the user opens the application, then the interface is displayed in the browser.
Given the interface, when the user works with it, then no separate client is needed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: To achieve a faster battery charging a higher voltage is set after the start of the engine until the battery is nearly fully charged.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want a higher charging voltage after engine start until the battery is nearly full, so that the battery charges faster.
technical_task: Set a higher charging voltage after the engine starts and keep it until the battery is nearly fully charged.
acceptance_criteria: Given the engine has started, when charging begins, then a higher voltage is set.
Given the battery is nearly fully charged, when charging continues, then the higher voltage is no longer applied.
rationale: Role assumed: vehicle engineer. The voltage values and the "nearly full" threshold are not given.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to perform staff reviews to validate application compliance with zoning ordinances.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to carry out staff reviews, so that applications are checked against zoning ordinances.
technical_task: Provide a staff review function that validates application compliance with zoning ordinances.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application, when a staff member performs a staff review, then compliance with zoning ordinances is validated.
Given a completed review, when it is viewed, then its result is recorded for the application.

requirement_text: User shall display only 10 matching results on the current screen.
user_story: As a user, I want the current screen to show only 10 matching results, so that the page stays short.
technical_task: Limit the results list on a screen to 10 matching results.
acceptance_criteria: Given more than 10 matches, when the results screen is displayed, then only 10 are shown.
Given 10 or fewer matches, when the results screen is displayed, then all of them are shown.

requirement_text: System shall enable easy listing of summit agendas.
clarification_questions: What does "easy" listing of summit agendas mean in measurable terms?
Who lists the agendas and what information is listed?

requirement_text: An LHCP or UAP can add and delete patients from his or her monitoring list.
user_story: As an LHCP or UAP, I want to add and delete patients on my monitoring list, so that it shows who I follow.
technical_task: Allow an LHCP or UAP to add patients to and remove patients from their own monitoring list.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when an LHCP or UAP adds the patient to the monitoring list, then the patient appears on it.
Given a patient on the list, when the LHCP or UAP deletes the patient, then the patient is removed from it.

requirement_text: The NE shall support class 1 and class 2 bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.3.2.5) support class 1 and class 2 bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want the NE to support class 1 and class 2 bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec, so that traffic is carried.
technical_task: Support class 1 and class 2 bandwidth in the NE with a rate of at least 1 Mbyte/sec.
acceptance_criteria: Given class 1 traffic, when it is carried by the NE, then a bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec is supported.
Given class 2 traffic, when it is carried by the NE, then a bandwidth of at least 1 Mbyte/sec is supported.

requirement_text: System shall prioritize the safety of human users during operation.
clarification_questions: Which safety standards or measurable safety behaviours apply?
What does "prioritize" mean when safety and other goals conflict?

requirement_text: The user can manipulate and view fee details, including tuition fees, exam fees, and donation fees.
user_story: As a student, I want to view and manage fee details such as tuition, exam and donation fees, so that I can keep track of what I owe.
technical_task: Provide viewing and editing of fee details including tuition fees, exam fees and donation fees.
acceptance_criteria: Given fee details, when the user opens the fee page, then tuition fees, exam fees and donation fees are shown.
Given a fee detail, when the user changes it and saves, then the change is stored.

requirement_text: Communication services shall provide a "pipe" communication mechanism allowing immediate message passing through the network and allowing a 50hz FCP transfer task to poll until it can read an immediate message from the ICP.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS067] provide a "pipe" communication mechanism allowing immediate message passing through the network and allowing a 50hz FCP transfer task to poll until it can read an immediate message from the ICP.
user_story: As a software developer, I want a "pipe" communication mechanism for immediate message passing, so that a 50hz FCP transfer task can poll until it reads an immediate message from the ICP.
technical_task: Provide a "pipe" mechanism in the communication services for immediate message passing across the network, and let a 50hz FCP transfer task poll until it can read an immediate message from the ICP.
acceptance_criteria: Given the communication services, when a message is sent through the "pipe", then it is passed immediately through the network.
Given a 50hz FCP transfer task, when it polls the pipe, then it reads the immediate message from the ICP once available.

requirement_text: A user (an LHCP or patient) chooses to display his or her appointments in the current month on a calendar for the current month.
user_story: As an LHCP or patient, I want to see this month's appointments on a calendar for the current month, so that I can plan my time.
technical_task: Offer a calendar view of the appointments in the current month for LHCPs and patients.
acceptance_criteria: Given appointments in the current month, when the user chooses to display them, then they appear on a calendar for the current month.
Given a patient user, when the calendar is displayed, then it lists the patient's own appointments.

requirement_text: The solution should limit access to pertinent functions and views only for patient records covered by the audit.
user_story: As an auditor, I want access limited to the functions and views needed for patient records under audit, so that unrelated records stay protected.
technical_task: Restrict access to the pertinent functions and views to patient records covered by the audit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient record covered by the audit, when an auditor opens it, then the pertinent functions and views are available.
Given a patient record not covered by the audit, when an auditor tries to open it, then access is limited.

requirement_text: User shall specify security measures and access controls.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to specify security measures and access controls, so that the system is protected as I decide.
technical_task: Provide settings in which the user specifies security measures and access controls.
acceptance_criteria: Given the security settings, when the user specifies a security measure and saves, then it is stored.
Given the security settings, when the user specifies an access control and saves, then it is applied.

requirement_text: The system shall prioritize continuous operation and ensure that any interruptions can be demonstrably attributed to a trusted operating system issue.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want continuous operation with any interruption traceable to a trusted operating system issue, so that causes are known.
technical_task: Keep the system running continuously and make sure each interruption can be demonstrated to come from a trusted operating system issue.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is in operation, when it runs, then it keeps operating continuously.
Given an interruption, when it is analysed, then it can be shown to be attributed to a trusted operating system issue.
rationale: Role assumed: operations manager. No availability figure is given.

requirement_text: Memory shall be categorized into congruent (identical data) and non-congruent (data that is not identical) memory.
requirement_text_raw: Memory shall (3.3.9.1) be categorized into congruent (identical data) and non-congruent (data that is not identical) memory.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want memory split into congruent and non-congruent memory, so that identical data is kept apart from data that differs.
technical_task: Organize memory into congruent memory, which holds identical data, and non-congruent memory, which holds data that is not identical.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory holding identical data on every member, when it is categorized, then it is congruent memory.
Given memory holding data that is not identical across members, when it is categorized, then it is non-congruent memory.

requirement_text: The contractor shall ensure that the control unit sets a fault code in the control unit for each short circuit and open load detected in the inputs and outputs.
user_story: As a diagnostics engineer, I want the control unit to set a fault code for every short circuit and open load at its inputs and outputs, so that faults are recorded.
technical_task: Have the control unit store a fault code for each short circuit and each open load detected on an input or output.
acceptance_criteria: Given a short circuit is detected at an input or output, when it is detected, then a fault code is set in the control unit.
Given an open load is detected at an input or output, when it is detected, then a fault code is set in the control unit.

requirement_text: System shall maintain backward compatibility and smooth dependency installation for Ubuntu 10.04 LTS.
user_story: As a developer, I want the system to stay backward compatible and install dependencies smoothly on Ubuntu 10.04 LTS, so that it runs on that release.
technical_task: Keep the system backward compatible and make dependency installation work on Ubuntu 10.04 LTS.
acceptance_criteria: Given Ubuntu 10.04 LTS, when the dependencies are installed, then the installation completes.
Given Ubuntu 10.04 LTS, when the system is run, then it works as in newer releases.
rationale: Role assumed: developer. "Smooth" is read as completing without manual fixes.

requirement_text: A user researcher shall develop the user research protocol for internal workflows.
user_story: As a user researcher, I want to write the user research protocol for internal workflows, so that studies follow a plan.
technical_task: Produce a user research protocol that covers internal workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Given internal workflows, when the user researcher prepares the work, then a user research protocol is developed.
Given the protocol, when it is reviewed, then it covers internal workflows.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to rename scores they own.
user_story: As a user, I want to rename the scores I own, so that I can keep them organized.
technical_task: Allow renaming of scores by their owners.
acceptance_criteria: Given a score owned by the user, when the user renames it, then the new name is saved.
Given a score owned by someone else, when the user tries to rename it, then it is refused.

requirement_text: The system shall be scalable to accommodate increasing document volumes without performance degradation.
clarification_questions: What document volume and growth must be supported?
What performance level counts as no "degradation"?

requirement_text: System shall display a login window on the theaa.com website for each user.
user_story: As a user, I want a login window on the theaa.com website, so that I can sign in.
technical_task: Display a login window on the theaa.com website for every user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user on the theaa.com website, when the page is opened, then a login window is displayed.
Given the login window, when the user enters valid credentials, then the user is signed in.

requirement_text: Actions and statuses recorded in accordance with paragraph (d)(2)(i) of this section must not be capable of being changed overwritten or deleted by the EHR technology.
requirement_text_raw: Actions and statuses recorded in accordance with paragraph (d)(2)(i) of this section must not be capable of being changed  overwritten  or deleted by the EHR technology.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want recorded actions and statuses protected from change, overwrite or deletion by the EHR technology, so that the record stays trustworthy.
technical_task: Prevent the EHR technology from changing, overwriting or deleting actions and statuses recorded under paragraph (d)(2)(i).
acceptance_criteria: Given an action recorded under paragraph (d)(2)(i), when a user tries to change it, then the EHR technology refuses.
Given a status recorded under paragraph (d)(2)(i), when a user tries to overwrite or delete it, then the EHR technology refuses.

requirement_text: The TCS shall be capable of storing a minimum of 500 mission plans under unique names to allow for later retrieval.
requirement_text_raw:
The TCS shall be capable of storing a minimum of 500 mission plans under unique names to allow for later
retrieval.
user_story: As an operator, I want the TCS to store at least 500 mission plans under unique names, so that I can retrieve them later.
technical_task: Support storage of a minimum of 500 mission plans, each saved under a unique name.
acceptance_criteria: Given 500 mission plans, when they are stored, then each is saved under a unique name.
Given a stored mission plan, when the operator enters its name, then the plan is retrieved.

requirement_text: System shall allow user registration without any preconditions.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to register without any preconditions, so that I can sign up quickly.
technical_task: Allow user registration with no precondition.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor, when the visitor registers, then no precondition is checked.
Given a completed registration, when the visitor signs in, then the account works.

requirement_text: Communication services shall perform synchronous message passing at rate group frame boundaries. This ensures that all redundant instantiations of a given rate group task have consistent messages throughout the rate group frame.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS054] perform synchronous message passing at rate group frame boundaries. This ensures that all redundant instantiations of a given rate group task have consistent messages throughout the rate group frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want synchronous message passing at rate group frame boundaries, so that redundant instances see the same messages through the frame.
technical_task: Perform synchronous message passing in the communication services at rate group frame boundaries so that all redundant instantiations of a rate group task have consistent messages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a rate group frame boundary, when it is reached, then synchronous message passing is performed.
Given redundant instantiations of a rate group task, when the frame runs, then all see consistent messages throughout the rate group frame.

requirement_text: Customers shall finalize payment by cash using the bill mode.
user_story: As a customer, I want to finalize my payment by cash in bill mode, so that I can settle the bill.
technical_task: Allow payment to be completed by cash in the bill mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bill mode, when the customer chooses cash, then the payment can be finalized.
Given a finalized cash payment, when the bill is viewed, then it is shown as paid.

requirement_text: Users shall remove stocks from their portfolio.
user_story: As an investor, I want to remove stocks from my portfolio, so that it shows only what I hold.
technical_task: Provide removal of stocks from a portfolio.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock in the portfolio, when the user removes it, then it is no longer in the portfolio.
Given a removed stock, when the portfolio is viewed, then the stock is not listed.

requirement_text: User shall find the Gambler Agent application's client side very easy to use and enjoyable, with a simple interface allowing newcomers to quickly start playing.
clarification_questions: How is "very easy to use" and "enjoyable" measured?
How quickly must a newcomer be able to start playing?

requirement_text: Reports on total system sales, jobs, job seekers, accounting, and order history shall be viewable.
user_story: As a manager, I want reports on total sales, jobs, job seekers, accounting and order history, so that I can follow the business.
technical_task: Provide viewable reports on total system sales, jobs, job seekers, accounting and order history.
acceptance_criteria: Given the reports area, when the manager opens it, then reports on sales, jobs, job seekers, accounting and order history can be viewed.
Given a report, when it is opened, then it displays the totals for the system.

requirement_text: The system shall be accompanied by well-documented code, user documentation, and help systems, all designed for clarity and ease of understanding.
clarification_questions: What documentation deliverables and level of detail are required?
How is "clarity and ease of understanding" measured?

requirement_text: The website shall be compatible with all browsers.
user_story: As a visitor, I want the website to work in any browser, so that I can use the browser I like.
technical_task: Make the website compatible with browsers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supported browser, when the visitor opens the website, then it displays and works.
Given a different browser, when the visitor opens the website, then it displays and works.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. The list of browsers is not given, so "all" is taken as the browsers the team selects.

requirement_text: The system shall validate data integrity and format compliance during ingest.
user_story: As a data steward, I want data integrity and format compliance validated at ingest, so that bad data is caught early.
technical_task: Validate the integrity and format compliance of data when it is ingested.
acceptance_criteria: Given data being ingested, when it is checked, then its integrity is validated.
Given data in an invalid format, when it is ingested, then it fails format compliance.

requirement_text: The Patient Encounters & Documents page at the bottom of the screen displays a list of all encounters that have been entered for this patient.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the Patient Encounters & Documents page to list every encounter entered for the patient, so that I can review the history.
technical_task: Show on the Patient Encounters & Documents page a list of all encounters entered for the patient.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with encounters, when the page is opened, then all entered encounters are listed.
Given the page layout, when it is displayed, then the list appears at the bottom of the screen.

requirement_text: For details refer to specification "Masterdatenblatt Verdampferplatte - Batteriekühlung", see [HVB3_R-136].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced specification require?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: User shall be able to block other users through the system.
user_story: As a user, I want to block other users, so that they cannot contact me.
technical_task: Provide a function to block other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given another user, when the user blocks them, then the blocked user is recorded.
Given a blocked user, when they try to contact the user, then the contact is prevented.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The effect of blocking is an interpretation.

requirement_text: Company logos shall be attachable to job adverts.
user_story: As an employer, I want to attach my company logo to job adverts, so that adverts show my brand.
technical_task: Allow company logos to be attached to job adverts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a job advert, when the employer attaches a company logo, then the logo is saved with the advert.
Given an advert with a logo, when it is viewed, then the logo is shown.

requirement_text: System shall trigger the mail message generator to send emails to customers and agents as needed.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the mail message generator triggered to email customers and agents when needed, so that they stay informed.
technical_task: Trigger the mail message generator to send emails to customers and agents as required.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event that requires a notification, when it occurs, then the mail message generator is triggered.
Given the triggered generator, when it runs, then emails are sent to the customers and agents concerned.
rationale: Role assumed: system administrator. "As needed" is not defined.

requirement_text: FTSS shall initialize congruent initialized memory locations from non-volatile memory.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS200] initialize congruent initialized memory locations from non-volatile memory.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to load congruent initialized memory locations from non-volatile memory, so that they start with known values.
technical_task: Initialize congruent initialized memory locations in FTSS with values read from non-volatile memory.
acceptance_criteria: Given FTSS is initializing, when it processes congruent initialized memory locations, then they are set from non-volatile memory.
Given the initialization is complete, when the locations are read, then they hold the values from non-volatile memory.

requirement_text: The latest Buckle sensor specification shall be referenced for detail regarding sensor output characteristics.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What do the latest Buckle sensor specification and its sensor output characteristics say?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?
